name: Malaika
face: Young Congolese girl with warm medium-brown skin, a round face, large dark brown eyes, soft brows, a small nose, rosy cheeks, and a wide joyful smile.
clothing: Knee-length short-sleeved dress in a magenta, pink, green, and gold geometric print, with a gold-trimmed square neckline and a large bow at the waist. Tall wrapped headscarf in the same magenta, pink, green, and gold pattern. Small gold hoop earrings, a short gold bead necklace, white ankle socks, and brown strappy sandals.
proportions: A real child of about eight, with a natural head-to-body ratio, two arms, two legs, and five fingers on each hand.
distinctiveFeatures: Tall wrapped headscarf covering most of her black hair with a few curls at the nape, gold hoop earrings, gold bead necklace, waist bow, and white socks with brown sandals.
